entities.summary: Rubby Nick De La Rosa Corporan is a Dominican former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Los Angeles Dodgers, Boston Red Sox, and Arizona Diamondbacks, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Yomiuri Giants.
